messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Tenth protocol. All the data contradicts itself because we asked the wrong questions.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: We were looking for what the creature would become. The real question is what we accept not controlling.

choices.label: I keep looking for a stable formula, even an imperfect one.
I accept that it remains changing and alive.
I let it choose the bond's next direction.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Command orders its transfer. Officially, it is an unstable entity. Unofficially, they want to know whether it can be reproduced.

choices.label: I obey the transfer, but impose a protection protocol.
I refuse the transfer. The lab lost the right to decide alone.
I propose contact with the outside signal under observation.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Final answer, soldier. Do not look for the perfect solution. Choose the responsibility you can carry.

choices.label: I entrust it to human protocol, with me as permanent witness.
I let it leave toward what calls it, even if I lose the bond.
I stay with it to learn, without pretending to finish it.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Even now, you are looking for a formula. I understand that temptation: it is mine too.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: That is a clean break. The soldier is still answering, but he is no longer asking permission.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Then the protocol does not end in possession, but in presence. I can live with that conclusion.
